decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already fully captures use of replacement-contract mint statistics, exclusion of old-contract NFTs, and numbering restarting at #1.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already makes the countdown use only the replacement contract's new draw cycle and excludes old draw progress.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits visible ticket accounting to replacement-contract NFTs and new draws while excluding old-contract ticket state.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already requires the dashboard inventory to use replacement-contract ownership and exclude old-contract NFTs.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already restricts public referral statistics to replacement-contract NFTs and excludes old-contract referrals.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already restricts displayed referral counts to replacement-contract NFT records and excludes old-contract records.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits active commission displays to replacement-contract referrals and excludes old-contract commission records.
Starting fresh on a replacement contract does not change the required metadata attributes of each NFT; the existing metadata rules remain valid unchanged.
The contract migration decision does not alter the requirements for rendering NFT covers or wallet images.
The existing message-539 INTRODUCE already fully records the replacement-contract fresh start, numbering restart, exclusion of the legacy contract, and absence of a copy-migration requirement.
The About-page content at this time contains no old-contract statistics or continuity claims that the migration decision necessarily changes.
The FAQ's product-mechanics explanations remain valid for replacement-contract NFTs and do not require a migration disclosure or historical-state update.
